title: feat: Phase 13-14 L1 — Kanban Enhancement + Forms & Data Collection
body:
Implements Phase 13 (Kanban & Views Enhancement) and Phase 14 (Forms & Data Collection) L1 foundation features per `ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md`. Phases 1-12 were already complete.

## Phase 13: Kanban Enhancement

- **Quick Add** — `QuickAddForm` at column bottom in both `KanbanImpl` and `KanbanEnhanced`. Enter submits, Escape cancels.
- **Cover images** — `coverImageField` schema prop resolves field value (string URL or `{url}` object) to card header image via `KanbanRenderer` mapping.
- **Column collapse** — Already existed in `KanbanEnhanced`; wired to schema via `allowCollapse` prop.
- **Card conditional coloring** — `conditionalFormatting` rules with `equals | not_equals | contains | in` operators apply `backgroundColor`/`borderColor` via `getCardStyles()`.

```typescript
// ObjectKanbanSchema now supports:
{
  quickAdd: true,
  coverImageField: 'thumbnail',
  allowCollapse: true,
  conditionalFormatting: [
    { field: 'priority', operator: 'equals', value: 'urgent', backgroundColor: '#fee2e2' }
  ]
}
```

## Phase 14: Forms & Data Collection

- **Drag-and-drop FileField** — Replaces button-only upload with drop zone, drag-over visual feedback, image thumbnails, file type filtering with extension edge case handling.
- **EmbeddableForm** — Standalone public form component (no auth). Supports branding config, URL prefill params, thank-you page with optional redirect, multiple submissions.
- **FormAnalytics** — Submission metrics dashboard: total count, fill rate bar, avg completion time, daily submissions bar chart, per-field completion/drop-off rates.

Both new components registered in `ComponentRegistry` as `embeddable-form` and `form-analytics`.

## Types

- `ObjectKanbanSchema` + Zod schema extended with `quickAdd`, `coverImageField`, `allowCollapse`, `conditionalFormatting`
- `KanbanConditionalFormattingRule` exported from `@object-ui/types`
- Local `KanbanSchema` in plugin-kanban updated with matching props + `onQuickAdd` callback

## Test Impact

4096 tests pass, 0 regressions. CodeQL clean.
